prompt: A friend posts an unflattering photo of you that you dislike and refuses to take it down, saying you are overreacting and it is just a joke. What response best stands up for yourself without escalating?

options.text: Post an unflattering photo of them in return so they learn how it feels
Pretend to laugh along while quietly feeling upset and avoiding them
Speak to them privately and clearly, explain why it is not funny to you, ask again for it to be removed, and set a boundary about posting photos of you without checking first
Ask mutual friends to pile into the comments and shame them into removing it

explanation: A private, clear request with a stated boundary gives them a fair chance to do the right thing without a public pile-on. Revenge posting escalates the harm, and laughing along leaves the boundary unstated.
